applications.deductions:
' WORKERS WILL BE PAID FOR ALL HOURS WORKED AT THE WAGE RATE IN EFFECT AT THE TIME THE WORK IS PERFORMED, AS REQUIRED AT 20 CFR 655.122(l) AND PER SECTION H-2A OF THE INA. THE REQUIRED WAGE MAY BE DIFFERENT THAN IT IS AT THE TIME OF FILING THIS JOB OFFER. THE EMPLOYER WILL USE A SINGLE WORKWEEK AS ITS STANDARD FOR COMPUTING WAGES DUE. WORKERS WILL BE PAID BI-WEEKLY. FEDERAL AND STATE TAXES WILL BE DEDUCTED, AS WELL AS MEALS, IF APPLICABLE.

IN ACCORDANCE WITH 20 CFR 655.122(p)(1-2):
1. A WEEKLY INTERNET ACCESS FEE OF UP TO $10 MAY BE DEDUCTED.
2. A FEE OF UP TO $25 MAY BE DEDUCTED FOR EACH INSTANCE IN WHICH AN EMPLOYEE USES THE EMPLOYER'S VEHICLE FOR NON-WORK RELATED PERSONAL ACTIVITIES NOT RELATED TO OBTAINING BASIC SUPPLIES AND PROVISIONS.
